Thin ergonomic helpers over the raw bindings.

The per-header modules stay verbatim C. This module adds the four things almost every caller needs: UTF-8 string conversion both ways, one-shot script evaluation, and scoped context lifetime.

Imports

jsbase, jsstringref, jscontextref, jsvalueref, jsobjectref

Procs

proc `$`(str: JSStringRef): string {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Converts a JSString to a Nim UTF-8 string. Never fails; nil gives "". 
proc evalScript(ctx: JSContextRef; script: string;
                thisObject: JSObjectRef = nil; sourceURL: string = "";
                line: int = 1; exception: var JSValueRef): JSValueRef {.
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Evaluates script and returns the result (nil on exception, with exception[] set). exception must be initialized to nil by the caller. 
proc newJSString(s: string): JSStringRef {....raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Wraps s in a JSString. Owned: release with JSStringRelease.

Templates

template withGlobalContext(ctx: untyped; body: untyped)
Creates a global context, runs body, releases it. Usage: withGlobalContext(ctx): ....
